query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street = 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as street_null_string,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as street_actual_null,
  SUM(CASE WHEN street = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as street_empty,
  SUM(CASE WHEN zip IS NULL OR zip = '' OR zip = 'NULL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as no_zip
FROM pco_people WHERE status = 'active';
